_about: Answers of GET /api/account/characters/{id}/next-step for made-up saves, from the API's NextStepPlanner (hvmhfz_rest_api branch next-step-api, 5f8dd18): HR1 with one Key Quest cleared, HR4 with three, GR 37, GR 650. Used by dev/check-next-step.js; regenerate when the API's words change.

hr1.summary: HR1 (HR 1), now HR 1. Key Quests: 1 of 6 cleared.
hr1.recommended: Clear the Key Quests left, starting with "Hunt the Boar Chief!". Then the Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Unknown Species, Fierce Wyvern" appears.
details: Key Quests left: "Hunt the Boar Chief!", "Chasing the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry", "Congalala's Territory", "Daimyo at the Water's Edge", "Great Forest Hypnocatrice".
Key Quests cleared: "Habitat of the Azure Hunter".
Urgent Quest "[Urgent] Unknown Species, Fierce Wyvern": appears in Quest Counter > Hunter Quests > Urgent Quests once every Key Quest is cleared. Clearing it raises your HR cap to 30 (HR2).

gr37.summary: GR 37: all of G★1-7 is open. Next milestone: G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence at GR50 (13 GR to go).
gr37.recommended: Build the Furogada or Samurai set from G★1-3 quests (the Hunter Navi GR tasks lead you through it), then move on to G★4-5.
details: GR50: buy the G Rank Pugi Cuff Licence from the Pugi Farm Manager (60P) to wear G Rank cuffs.
GR300: ★1 Zenith monsters (Zenith Monster Quests on the G counter) and Zenith armour and weapons. Until the coming game update it opens at GR200.
GR500: G Exotic quests (★8), for Exotic weapon upgrades.
GR500: ★2 Zenith monsters. Until the coming game update it opens at GR400.
GR700: ★3 Zenith monsters. Until the coming game update it opens at GR600.
GR800: G Finesse upgrades: G Exotic monsters hunted from GR800 give their materials.
GR900: ★4 Zenith monsters, the hardest standard fights in the game. Until the coming game update it opens at GR800.
notes: Coming game update: Zenith ★1, Zenith ★2, Zenith ★3 and Zenith ★4 move to GR 300, 500, 700 and 900 (GR 200, 400, 600 and 800 in the game now). The GR shown here are the new ones.
